title: turath-catalog manuscripts
description: Manuscript copies in the library: where the manuscript itself is kept, as the copy shows it.

manuscript_id.description: Stable id: `m_` + first 10 hex digits of sha1 of the edition id.

edition_id.description: The copy as an edition row (kind = manuscript).

holding_library_ar.description: Library that holds the manuscript (as its stamp, card or ownership note shows). Empty when the copy does not show it.

shelfmark.description: Shelfmark or number in that library.

holding_confidence.description: `high`: read in the copy itself; `medium`: from the upload's own description; `low`: probable (the copy suggests it).

printed_edition_id.description: A printed edition of the same work in the dataset, when there is one.
